model_output.verdict: A branch manager with deposit growth and unaccounted time since December 2024.
write_up: You worked your way from Personal Banker to Branch Manager at Magnolia Community Bank, growing deposits along the way. It's common for a resume to stop at the last job, but the unaccounted time since December 2024 gives a recruiter a question they may not stop to ask.

Your deposit-growth line is the model: it names the business measure and shows where it started and finished. The branch's 11 employees also give a recruiter a useful picture of your management responsibility, though the resume says less about what the team handled.

Let's start with the time after the Branch Manager role, then add detail to the team, coaching and audit work. Those answers can help a recruiter see both where you've been and how you ran the branch.
